Name: Arboretum Greenhouse V2
Author: Draylon
Description:
A Greenhouse Layout Purely for Trees

I wanted to put all the trees from PPJA's More Trees and the base game into the greenhouse, but there wasn't enough space, so I made enough space :)
Thought I'd share.

[size=4]Compatibility[/size]
Should Be compatible with all recolors
Won't be compatible with SVE as From what I understand they do their own stuff with the greenhouse.

[size=5]Version 2.0 Update![/size]

Now Has 5 Size Options!
In the config you can set it to 40, 70, 150, 300, or 500 spaces for trees.
Also you now have the ability to turn on/off Decorations.

If you were on a previous version you will need to grab a mod to transplant trees (There are several on nexus) and may have to shift around your machines/chests etc, as I've slightly adjusted the amount of space around the edges [Adding 1 more tile to walk on around the edges].

I've also decided to utilize [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9633]Extra Map Layers[/url] to make it so you can put stuff on the immediate edge around the tree area. (where you couldn't before)
THIS MEANS YOU NEED TO DOWNLOAD EXTRA MAP LAYERS (It will still work without it but it will lack the little wooden border between brick and dirt)

[size=5]Please let me know if I messed up or broke something![/size]
